senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अजति)
1 To go.
2 To blame, or censure: the root is irregular, वी being substituted for it before many of the inflections, as विवाय, वीयात्, &c. with an indicatory
इ। अजि r. 10th cl. (अञ्जयति)
To shine.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 Also of VIṢṆU.
3 A name of ŚIVA.
4 Also of KĀMA or CUPID.
5 A proper name, the son of RAGHU, and father of DĀŚARATHA.
6 A he-goat.
7 A sheep.
8 A mineral substance. See माक्षिक.
f. (-जा)
1 A she-goat.
2 Illusion, the unreality of the universe, personified as Śakti.
mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Unborn.
E.
अ neg. and ज born, unborn; or अज to go, aff. अच्.

n. (-जं)
Oiled butter.
E.
आङ्, अज to go, अच् aff.

m. (-र्णः)
1 The ear of a goat.
2 A tree, (Terminalia alata tomentosa, Rox.) See असन.
E.
अज a goat, कर्ण an ear; the leaf being compared to the ear of a goat.

m. (-कः)
A tree, vulg. Śāl, (Shorea robusta, Rox.) See शाल.
E.
क affixed to the preceding, denoting resemblance.

m. (-वः)
The bow of ŚIVA. See अजकाव अजगव, &c.
E.
अज VIṢṆU, and क BRAHMĀ, with ब aff. BRAHMĀ being placed in the centre, and VIṢṆU on the upper part.

m. (-वः)
See अजकव.
E.
as before, अ being made आ.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant, (Ocymum gratissimum.)
E.
अज a goat, and गन्ध small; smelling like a goat.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Ocymum gratissimum.) See अजगन्धा.

f. (-नी)
A plant. See अजशृङ्गी.
E.
See अजगन्धा.

m. (-रः)
The Bor, or Boa, a large serpent. (Boa constrictor.)
E.
अज a goat, and गर who swallows, from गृ with अच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Not wakeful, not awake.
m. (-रः)
A plant, (Eclipta or verbesina prostrata.)
E.
अ neg. and जागर wakeful.

n. (-वं)
The bow of ŚIVA. See अजकव, &c.

n. (-वं)
See अजगव, &c.

n. (-बं)
The bow of ŚIVA.
E.
see अजकाव.

m. (-कः)
A goatherd.
E.
अज, and जीविक who lives or gets a livelihood by goats.

f. (-टा)
The name of a plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) Also written अञ्झडा and अञ्झटा.
E.
अ neg. and जट a fibrous root; or अ and जड foolish, brightening the intellects.

f. (-थ्या)
A plant, (Yellow jasmin.)
E.
अज, and थ्यन् aff. of propriety or fitness.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
One not a parent or producer, unproductive, ungenerative.
E.
अ neg. जनक generator.

m. (-निः)
Privation of birth, used as an imprecation. See अकरणि, &c. Ex. अजननिरस्तु तस्य may he cease to exist.
E.
अ priv. and जननि birth.

m. (-न्तः)
(In grammar) A noun ending in a vowel.
E.
अच् the syllable including all the vowels, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म)
Unborn.
E.
अ neg. जन्मन् birth.

n. (-न्यं)
A portent, an omen; any natural phenomenon, as an earthquake, &c. so considered.
mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Not to be born or produced.
E.
अ neg. and जन्य birth.

m. (-पः)
1 A reader of works considered heterodox.
2 A goatherd.
f. (-पा)
1 A particular mantra or mystical formula employed by the Tāntrikas, the essence of which is in the letters H and S, whence it is termed the Haṃsa mantra.
2 ŚIVA and ŚAKTI combined, to which form, the mantra is particularly addressed.
mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Who or what does not perform the Japa.
2 Cherishing or feeding goats.
E.
अ not, and जप silent prayer; or अज a goat, and प who protects.

m. (-ढः)
A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA; the friend of AJA, i. e.
E.
अज VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and ईह to seek, to love, with the participial क्त, the termination of the accusative is retained.

f. (-दा)
1 Common carroway, (Carum carui.)
2 A kind of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)
3 A sort of parsley, (Apium involucratum); this latter application is the one used in the dialects.
E.
अज a goat, and मोद what pleases, from मुट्.

m. (-म्भः)
A frog.

m. (-यः)
Defeat.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unsurpassed, unsubdued, over whom or which no triumph is obtained.
f. (-या)
Hemp.
E.
अ neg. जय victory.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Invincible, not to be subdued or surpassed.
E.
अ neg. जय्य conquerable.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Friendship.
2 Imperishableness, exemption from infirmity or decay.
mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Imperishable, undecaying.
E.
अ neg. and जर्य्य from जॄ to decay.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Imperishable, undecaying.
f. (-रा)
Aloes.
E.
अ neg. जरा decay.

n. (-नं)
Antimony.

m. (-मा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
अज, and लोमन् the hair of the body, hair, wool.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A plant; described as a milky and thorny plant, with a fruit of a crooked figure, like a ram's horn, and used as a medicine for the eyes; vulg, Mera Śṛṅgī, and Kaṅkara Śṛṅgī. See कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.
E.
अज a ram, and शृङ्गी a horn.

n. Adverbial. (-स्रं)
Eternally, continually.
E.
अ neg. जस to let loose, and र aff.

f. (-र्था)
A figure of speech, metonymy, one name being put for another, as ‘the spears enter’ for the spearmen.
E.
अ neg. जहत् leaving, स्वार्थं sense.

m. (-ङ्गः)
In grammar, a noun that does not vary its gender; even when it is used attributively.
E.
अजहत् not leaving, लिङ्ग gender.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Not relinquishing, not leaving.
f. (-हा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
अज and ह, from हा to abandon.

f. (-जी)
Cumin seed.
E.
अज, a goat, and अज to go, affix ङीप्.

m. (-वः)
A goatherd; also अजाजीविन् अजापालकः, &c.
E.
अजा a she goat, and जीव who lives.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unborn, unproduced.
E.
अ neg. जात born.

m. (-त्रुः)
A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
अजात unborn, and शत्रु an enemy, who never made an enemy.

m. (-रिः)
See अजातशत्रु.

f. (-नी)
A small species of prickly nightshade.
E.
अज a goat, and अदन eating.

m. (-यः)
A horse of a good breed. See अजानेय.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fearless, undaunted.
E.
See अजानेय the initial being made short.

m. (-यः)
A horse of a good breed.
E.
अज to go, घञ् affix, आज going; आनेय to be taken: who carries the rider through all opposition, &c.

f. (-न्त्री)
A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) See female, छगलान्त्री.
E.
अज, and अन्त्र an entrail.

m. (-कः)
A goatherd.
E.
अजा a she goat, पाल to nourish, and वुन् aff.

n. (-कं)
A flock of goats.
E.
अज a goat, and बञ् aff.

m. (-रः)
ŚIVA'S bull.
E.
आज from अज to go, and कार what makes.
